note: The blank scenes the Slice 4 review collected over its rounds 7 to 13 for the comments painter (anchor-map.ts paintRendered and
its layout-time trim, trimCollapsedMarks): a fold's paragraphs, an author's figure, details, dl and center, badge rows, br pairs,
wrap points at several widths, a nbsp and an ideographic space, U+FEFF and the zero-width and bidi characters, svg icons, audio
with and without controls, an author pre with br and block children and with spaces or a tab between its block children (round
13: rendered under white-space: pre, so painted and kept), tables, footnote definitions, list items, a form feed, a CRLF, a floated
image, a picture without an image, ruby and rp, a space inside a kbd, a table caption, and a plain note. Each
scene is markdown from the paragraph 'Intro para.' to the paragraph 'After para.' and the width of the prose root it is laid
out at (the range painted runs from the first character of the one to the last of the other). No expected marks are recorded:
md-config-paint-trim-browser.test.ts reads the answer off the browser's layout for every scene (no blank mark of zero width, no
top-level mark, the trim removing blank marks alone, the unpaint exact). Two scenes are shaped around the pairing's recorded refusal
(plans/markdown-viewer.md, Slice 4 build note item 10 (d)): the broken-img scene's list item reads **z** so its stripped text differs from
the html block's bold before it (written **a** it painted nothing past that block); the stripped-comment scene hit the refusal as

the union's one recorded case until Slice 5's pairing (the html block takes its own element and no more; the shortened list item is a mismatch with its own element, and the paint reaches the closing paragraph in every scene). A CR is always the CRLF pair: to marked a lone CR before CRLF is a blank line, which ends an html block
(md-config-blank-scenes-fixture.test.ts pins it). Synthetic prose, no paths.
